text: 另外，想让做和不想让做是完全不同的两个维度的事情，简单点来说，想让做包含着希望、愿望，不想让做包含着无奈、妥协。

text: 中国几个世纪以来使用的理论依据是程朱理学，而中国之外基本上靠的是宗教，主要是基督教，因为基督教国家殖民了大半个世界。
en: The theoretical basis China used for centuries was Cheng-Zhu Neo-Confucianism, while outside China it has basically relied on religion, mainly Christianity, because Christian countries colonised the greater part of the world.

text: 当然，我知道其会导致人口贩卖，性病传播，更会削弱“家庭”这个组成社会的基本单位的数量和质量，所以我也很反对合法化，毕竟不管是性病泛滥，拐卖增加，还是家庭的减少都不是任何人想要看到的，有研究表明，在其他条件相似的情况下，家庭比例高的社会几乎在所有指标上表现都比原子人多的社会好。
en: Of course, I know it leads to human trafficking, the spread of sexually transmitted diseases, and further weakens the quantity and quality of "the family" — the basic unit that makes up society — so I am also firmly against legalisation. After all, neither the proliferation of STDs, the increase in abduction, nor the decline of families is anything anyone wants to see. Research shows that, all else being equal, societies with a higher proportion of families perform better on almost every indicator than societies with more atomised individuals.

text: 最后一个其实是全世界禁嫖的最主要原因，但也是最少被提及的一点，近十年结婚率雪崩，主要原因是什么大家都清楚。
en: The last point is actually the main reason prostitution is banned worldwide, yet it is the least mentioned one. The marriage rate has collapsed in the last decade, and everyone knows what the main reason is.

text: 真的想要提高结婚率需要打击的是谁也是众所周知的，这也是为什么有些人不敢提这个话题，因为一旦提了话题就会被引到“既然目标是稳固家庭，那么为什么不打击那个东西”，而这是那些人非常不想见到的。
en: Who really needs to be struck at in order to raise the marriage rate is also common knowledge, and that is why some people dare not raise this topic — because once it is raised, the conversation gets steered toward "since the goal is to stabilise families, why not strike at that thing", which is precisely what those people very much do not wish to see.

text: 不过上述这些原因只能说明了其会导致一些坏的后果，但这并不代表它本身是不道德的，而很多人在批判它时就仅仅说“这是不道德的，堕落的，罪恶的”所以必须被禁止，这本质上时一种循环论证，但就如开头所述，这种思想的根在中国已经消失了。
en: However, the reasons above only show that it leads to some bad consequences, but that does not mean it is immoral in itself. Yet many people, when criticising it, merely say "it is immoral, degenerate, sinful" and therefore must be banned — which is essentially a circular argument. But as stated at the beginning, the root of this way of thinking has already disappeared in China.

text: 最后，我认为卖淫应该被禁止，而且需要配合其他东西来增加人们组建家庭的意愿，不然其效果就大打折扣了。
en: Finally, I believe prostitution should be banned, and it needs to be paired with other measures to increase people's willingness to form families, otherwise its effect is greatly diminished.

text: 当然，如果你不认同这个逻辑，你还有人口贩卖和性病传播两个理由，但这两个理由相比促进家庭组建弱太多了。
en: Of course, if you do not accept this logic, you still have the two reasons of human trafficking and STD transmission, but these two reasons are far weaker than promoting family formation.

text: 首先是性病，有说法认为能强制定期检查反而会降低性病数量。
en: First, on STDs: there is a view that mandatory regular check-ups would actually reduce their numbers.

text: 拐卖这个理由稍微强一些， 合法化确实会增加人口贩卖（也有人说会减少，但是完全没有证据），但这不足以证明它应该被禁止，毕竟挖煤等高危行业每年会死很多人，却没有禁止。
en: The trafficking argument is slightly stronger. Legalisation would indeed increase human trafficking (some say it would reduce it, but there is absolutely no evidence), yet this is not enough to prove it should be banned — after all, high-risk industries such as coal mining kill many people every year, yet are not banned.

text: 当然，这个理由还是能说通的，只不过比较勉强。
en: Of course, this argument still holds up, only rather weakly.
